summary: Hua Hong's third 300 mm specialty foundry line in Wuxi, called the FAB9B project or Wuxi Phase III in its filings, to be run by the joint venture Wuxi Huahong Grace Semiconductor (Phase III) Manufacturing. Planned at USD 6.95 billion for about 55,000 wafers a month, it reuses existing production and utility buildings on Hua Hong's Wuxi base, adding cleanrooms and tools for logic, RF, image-sensor and non-volatile memory platforms. Construction was reported to have started in March 2026, the joint-venture agreements were signed and approved by shareholders in September 2026, and Hua Hong targets completing the line and starting production by December 2027.

notes: The first-half 2026 report names the project FAB9B and gives it a construction budget of about CNY 49.2 billion. The March 2026 construction start comes only from IT Home, read as republished by 10jqka; the original page was not found. Cailian Press also reported a February 2026 engineering, procurement and construction award of about CNY 3.78 billion for the FAB9B project. The shareholdings recorded here apply once the capital increase is registered with Chinese authorities.

review.method: Independent AI-assisted review (Claude): re-opened every cited source, checked each statement against it and searched for newer reporting.
review.changes: Corrected the Fab 9A company's registered name and formation date, added the Phase III project company as an operator party, and reworded the first-production note to match the trade-press report; no newer reporting changed the status. Audit fixes (2026-11-07): split from hua-hong-wuxi-fab-9, which merged the separately named Fab 9A and Fab 9B lines; this record keeps Fab 9B (Wuxi Phase III) with its joint-venture company as operator, takes the shareholders, investment, capacity, site address, platforms and December 2027 target from Hua Hong's September 2026 Hong Kong filings instead of the Securities Daily report hosted by 10jqka, relabels the IT Home report as read via 10jqka, and adds the first-half 2026 report and November 2026 results for construction progress.
